title: NIFTY Bank P/B Ratio
description: The NIFTY Bank P/B ratio today is 1.7 as of 15 Oct, 2026, against a 10-year median of 2.8. Price to book is generally more reliable than P/E for banks, because provisioning cycles distort reported earnings while book value moves more steadily.
